text: {"label":"Choice in Concurrent-Chains and Ratio Schedules","definition":"Studies of choice between alternatives arranged as concurrent chains or concurrent ratio schedules, examining initial- and terminal-link effects, preference measurement, choice dynamics, matching, and quantitative models of choice.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on concurrent-chains procedures and concurrent ratio choice, rather than multiple-schedule contrast and schedule-induced behavior, single interval schedule performance, or concurrent variable-interval schedules."}
